entities.summary: Skarszewy is a town in Starogard Gdański County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, northern Poland. It is located within the ethnocultural region of Kociewie in the historic region of Pomerania, 40 kilometres south of Gdańsk. Population: 6 809. It is the seat of the urban-rural administrative district Gmina Skarszewy.
